caption: This shoyu ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with nori, chashu, menma, and naruto fish cake, artfully arranged in a white ceramic bowl. Warm, ambient lighting highlights the dish against a dark wooden table.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a round, golden-brown slice with a slightly crispy, seared surface and visible marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and clear, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, curved pieces with a fibrous texture.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
Naruto fish cake: white, spiral-swirled, scalloped-edge, with pink swirl center and faint sear marks.
